note: Set B is better because it correctly identifies 'medium_density_foam' as the primary thick component in most claims and correctly notes 'CarbonUD' thickness as 0 mm where visible, whereas Set A inconsistently attributes the main bulk thickness to 'CarbonUD' or 'glass_biax' (contradicting the legend) and invents substantial CarbonUD thickness where none exists.
